description:
Update an integration

Changes the name, description, stored configuration or enabled flag of an integration. Only the fields you send are written. A `config` you send is merged with the stored one, one object level at a time. A field that is not secret takes the value you send, and one you leave out is removed, so send every non-secret field you want to keep. A secret field keeps its stored value when you leave it out or send it as `********`, an empty string or null clears it, and any other value replaces it. A value counts as secret when its field is declared with type `password` for the integration type, when its key contains `secret`, `password`, `passwd`, `token`, `apiKey`, `api_key`, `authorization`, `authValue`, `credential`, `bearer` or `cookie` or ends in `Key` (case-insensitive, at any depth), or when it is a URL that carries its secret inside it, such as the webhook URL of a Discord integration. A secret key covers everything below it. Booleans are never masked, and an empty value stays empty. Nested objects are merged by the same rules.

body.description: The fields to change. `config`, if sent, is merged with the stored configuration: fields that are not secret are replaced, secret fields left out or sent as `********` keep their stored value.
